title: Include Indigenous peoples in decisions affecting them
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Use representative institutions and good-faith consultation in laws, policies, research, and development affecting Indigenous communities.

title: Measure morality by inner transformation
definition: Judge spiritual progress by sustained efforts to overcome harmful tendencies and improve conduct.

title: Protect Indigenous languages and knowledge
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Support the transmission, revitalization, control, and responsible use of Indigenous languages and traditional knowledge.

title: Provide redress for dispossession and cultural harm
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Offer fair restitution, compensation, restoration, or other effective remedies for wrongful taking or destruction.

title: Respect Indigenous control of cultural heritage
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Recognize Indigenous authority concerning cultural objects, human remains, genetic resources, traditional knowledge, and cultural expression.

title: State technical claims honestly and realistically
definition: Base estimates, claims, forecasts, and representations on available evidence without distortion.

title: Avoid mental as well as physical theft
definition: Do not take, desire to take, or wrongfully withhold what belongs or is owed to another.

title: Avoid substances that impair health and judgment
definition: Abstain from harmful or irresponsible use of alcohol, tobacco, narcotics, and other intoxicating substances.

title: Care intelligently for the body
definition: Use health knowledge, rest, exercise, nutrition, and disciplined habits to protect bodily and mental well-being.

title: Do not be stingy with material or spiritual resources
definition: Share resources, knowledge, attention, and support rather than withholding them through selfishness.

title: Do not criticize others destructively
definition: Avoid speech that attacks others' character without necessity, fairness, or constructive purpose.

title: Do not hoard beyond reasonable need
definition: Limit accumulation that deprives others, dominates attention, or exceeds a responsible standard of living.

title: Do not pressure others into a spiritual path
definition: Respect each person's freedom to test teachings, follow conscience, or choose a different religious direction.

title: Do not withhold teaching or aid out of selfishness
definition: Share knowledge, guidance, and assistance when doing so is appropriate and beneficial.

title: Exercise inclusive and equitable governance
definition: Use authority in ways that include affected people, distribute power fairly, and improve collective well-being.

title: Fulfill vows and promises responsibly
definition: Honor legitimate commitments, ethical obligations, and freely undertaken spiritual or communal promises.

title: Join spiritual freedom with responsibility
definition: Treat inner freedom as inseparable from wisdom, accountability, and concern for the consequences of one's choices.

title: Learn to love as God loves
definition: Cultivate unconditional, wise, and responsible love that extends beyond preference or personal reward.

title: Make compassion a defining religious practice
definition: Treat compassion for suffering and vulnerable people as an essential expression of holiness rather than an optional activity.

title: Meet human need without discrimination
definition: Provide practical assistance according to need without discrimination based on identity, belief, status, or background.

title: Practice benevolent truthfulness
definition: Use thought and speech truthfully in ways directed toward welfare rather than cruelty, vanity, or avoidable harm.

title: Protect confidences entrusted through care
definition: Keep private information received through a helping or spiritual relationship in sacred confidence.

title: Refuse participation in organized violence
definition: Avoid taking up weapons or joining institutions whose purpose requires killing or partisan warfare.

title: Reject gambling and gain based on another's loss
definition: Avoid games and schemes in which hoped-for profit depends materially on the uncompensated loss of others.

title: Serve those in genuine need without expecting reward
definition: Accept effort or hardship for another's real welfare without seeking repayment, status, or recognition.

title: Test spiritual teachings through personal experience
definition: Examine spiritual claims through sincere practice, reflection, experience, and responsible judgment rather than coercion.

title: Treat every person as equally precious
definition: Recognize equal spiritual worth and the gifts each person can contribute.

title: Obtain informed consent
definition: Provide understandable information and respect voluntary decisions before interventions or research.

title: Protect medical confidentiality after death
definition: Continue protecting entrusted medical information after a patient's death.

title: Respect patient autonomy
definition: Honor capable patients' informed choices within ethical and legal limits.

title: Protect vulnerable sources
definition: Use heightened care with children, victims, confidential sources, and persons facing retaliation.

title: Maintain continuing competence
definition: Continue learning as knowledge, standards, risks, and technologies change.

title: Contribute to national and social solidarity
category: African Communal Duties and Peoples' Ethics
definition: Use one's abilities and resources to strengthen collective welfare rather than fragmentation or domination.

title: Preserve professional audit trails
definition: Maintain records sufficient to review consequential decisions and changes.

title: Provide age-appropriate guidance
definition: Support children's growing autonomy in a manner consistent with their evolving capacities.

title: Be accountable and transparent about reporting
definition: Explain decisions, correct errors promptly, and provide channels for legitimate criticism.

title: Minimize avoidable harm in public reporting
definition: Balance the public's need for information against foreseeable and unnecessary injury.

title: Protect Indigenous children from forced removal
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Do not separate Indigenous children from their families or communities through discriminatory or assimilationist policies.

title: Provide durable solutions for displaced people
definition: Pursue safe return, local integration, resettlement, or other secure long-term pathways.

title: Distinguish news from advertising and advocacy
definition: Label sponsored, promotional, opinion, and advocacy content so audiences are not deceived.

title: Do not forcibly assimilate Indigenous peoples
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Reject policies intended to erase Indigenous identity, culture, institutions, language, or collective existence.

title: Improve public understanding of technology
definition: Explain technological capabilities, consequences, risks, and limitations clearly enough to support informed decisions.

title: Maintain confidentiality after death
definition: Continue protecting confidential patient information even after the patient has died.

title: Obtain free, prior, and informed consent
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Seek genuine, timely, informed, and noncoercive consent before measures or projects significantly affect Indigenous peoples.

title: Protect Indigenous cultural and spiritual practices
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Safeguard ceremonies, sacred sites, traditions, institutions, and spiritual relationships from suppression or desecration.

title: Protect Indigenous lands, territories, and resources
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Respect Indigenous relationships to traditionally owned, occupied, used, or acquired lands, waters, and resources.

title: Reject ageism
category: Ethics of Ageing and Older Persons
definition: Do not demean, exclude, or disadvantage persons merely because of age.

title: Respect Indigenous self-determination
category: Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Ethical Duties
definition: Recognize Indigenous peoples' authority to determine their political status and pursue their own development.
